title: Vehicle Permit Fee Calculation Sheet, Community Rules & Site Care
content:
The monthly vehicle permit fee on a Community Rules & Site Care plan record is calculated for each month as follows.

1. **Permit-free allowance.** The permit-free allowance is the plan's included registered vehicles.
2. **Permits charged.** The permits charged for a month are the registered vehicles on the plan record less the permit-free allowance, and never fewer than zero.
3. **Permit rate.** The permit rate is the plan's monthly extra-vehicle permit fee, for each permit.
4. **Fee.** The monthly vehicle permit fee is the permits charged multiplied by the permit rate, rounded half up to the cent. It is never prorated.

The fee is charged for each month in which the permits charged come to one or more, dated the plan fee due day of that month and referenced to that month as its billing period. The registered vehicles are the registered vehicle count shown on the plan record.

## Worked example

Hypothetical plan figures, chosen for illustration only and not taken from any schedule: 1 included vehicle and a permit fee of $18.00.

| Registered vehicles on the plan record | Permits charged | Monthly vehicle permit fee |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | 0 | none charged for the month |
| 2 | 1 | $18.00 |
| 3 | 2 | $36.00 |

## Points of reading

- A site with fewer registered vehicles than its allowance has zero permits, never a negative number, and carries no fee for the month.
- The fee is a whole month's fee for every month it is charged; no part of a month is charged.
- Each month stands alone: the fee of one billing month is calculated from that month's registered vehicles.
